title: Anita in Paris and St. Tropez, her degrees and video work
summary: Anita explains her trip to Paris and St. Tropez, where she met Bud, her family's insistence on degrees, and her video projects.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: School days: grades, teachers and leaving school

blocks.x: And what were you doing in Paris?
Ah! Were you teaching here in New York then?

No, I was a school social worker. I was then. But I wasn't sure I was going to come back and I had a rich friend who had leased a villa in St. Tropez and invited all his friends over. So I went over and did a little singing and met Bud. Because, you know, I've always been interested in music.
They just, my family just said, no, no, no to show business. No, no, you get your degrees and you do that on the side, if necessary.
Where did you get your degrees?

Hunter ... (inaudible). Anyway, (I don't agree with that doctorate.)? (inaudible falsehood?). I don't know what I'd do with it. I just have to do video now with my crazy net video audience. I'm going around doing as much as I can on video tapes.
Well I watched you with the equipment the other night and I think something happened to it.
(Well that was Billy's?). As a matter of fact, he borrowed it and it didn't work.
It was just the way it was all set up, (unintelligible) planning for days and something is wrong with the equipment.
